2026_04_DET_CAR.headline: Detroit’s protection and passing game test Carolina’s depleted secondary
2026_04_DET_CAR.paragraph1: Detroit heads to Carolina with Jared Goff operating behind an offensive line the Lions say is setting the standard as a unit, giving Dan Campbell’s offense a chance to control protection and tempo. Carolina’s Bryce Young needs sustained drives to keep pace, but the Panthers enter the matchup with major secondary concerns after injuries to Jaycee Horn and Mike Jackson. That puts extra pressure on Carolina’s coverage depth against Amon-Ra St. Brown and Detroit’s passing game.
2026_04_DET_CAR.model_rationale: Detroit’s protection and receiving options can stress Carolina’s reduced secondary depth, while the Panthers need efficient quarterback play and longer possessions to limit that exposure.
